profile.shortBio:
I am a Fullstack Software Engineer, DevOps Engineer, and Network Infrastructure Specialist with extensive experience designing, developing, and deploying mission-critical systems across software, virtualization, and networking layers.

My engineering focus centers on high-throughput backend architectures with Laravel and Hono.js, reactive frontends using React and TypeScript, and enterprise-grade infrastructure. On the DevOps & server orchestration side, I specialize in bare-metal and cloud virtualization using Proxmox VE and VMware ESXi, Docker containerization, VPS fleet management, Linux server hardening, and Cloudflare edge services (R2, Hyperdrive, Turnstile, Tunnels).

In addition to building scalable web applications and POS platforms, I actively serve as an Informatics Educator at SMA Negeri 1 Gedeg, mentoring the next generation in computer science, DevOps workflows, and hands-on MikroTik & virtualization lab environments.

projects.title: AKAS V2 - Academic Security System
projects.desc: A comprehensive school discipline & academic monitoring platform. Migrated from legacy PHP Native monolith to modern Laravel API + React SPA architecture with Google OAuth, Cloudflare R2, and Progressive Web App support.
projects.content:
AKAS V2 is an enterprise academic safety and discipline management system designed specifically for high-capacity educational institutions.

### The Problem
Legacy monolithic systems previously suffered from high latency during morning peak hours when thousands of students tapped their physical RFID cards at the school gate simultaneously.

### Architecture & Solution
1. Decoupled the backend into high-performance Laravel 11 API endpoints with Redis queue caching.
2. Built an offline-first Progressive Web App (PWA) client interface using React SPA and Inertia.js.
3. Integrated Cloudflare R2 for zero-egress cost photo asset storage, drastically reducing operational server bandwidth overhead.
4. Configured automated Google OAuth single sign-on with role-based access control for administrative staff, teachers, and security officers.

projects.title: Satenya Mama Loesye - POS & Management System
projects.desc: Point of Sales & catering management system with a bold neobrutalist UI. Features Kitchen Display System synchronization, dynamic QRIS generation, WhatsApp OTP authentication, and delivery radius validation.
projects.content:
Satenya Mama Loesye is a custom-engineered Point of Sale (POS) and kitchen management system built for high-volume culinary catering operations.

### Core Engineering Highlights
- **Real-Time Kitchen Sync:** Orders punched at the cashier station appear on the kitchen display queue in under 80 milliseconds via lightweight WebSockets.
- **Dynamic QRIS Integration:** Automatic payment generation connected directly to payment gateway webhooks for immediate transaction settlement.
- **Neobrutalist Interface:** Designed specifically for touchscreens and tablet devices with tactile feedback and high-contrast accessibility.
- **Docker Containerization:** Fully containerized setup deployed across isolated Docker environments with automated health checks.

projects.title: ScholarGate SSO - Portal & CMS
projects.desc: Central school education portal and CMS designed for shared-hosting or VPS. Supports Google OAuth SSO, portable JSON data backups, and multi-database configurations.
projects.content:
ScholarGate serves as a centralized authentication hub and modern content management platform for academic communities.

### Key Capabilities
- **Unified Single Sign-On:** Seamless redirection with Google OAuth2 enabling teachers and students to log in without managing separate credentials.
- **Hybrid Database Agnostic Architecture:** Capable of running seamlessly on SQLite for simple self-contained deployments or scaling up to PostgreSQL.
- **Secure Data Exports:** Automated database backup tools generating verified JSON snapshots for offline archiving.

projects.title: SIEKSA V3 - School Extracurricular System
projects.desc: Web-based extracurricular administrative panel managing student directories, meeting logs, performance metrics, and automated achievement verification.
projects.content:
SIEKSA V3 is an open-source extracurricular management suite designed to eliminate paper-based logs and manual attendance rosters in schools.

### Highlights
- Built with high-speed Hono.js edge APIs and typed React UI.
- Integrated CSV analytics export for monthly activity compliance.
- Role-based approvals allowing mentors and student presidents to verify attendance logs digitally.
